station.name: Neuse River
station.source: BirdWeather public GraphQL detections (monthly windows) unioned with REST /api/v1/stations/4663/detections (daily windows), deduplicated by detection id
station.variant: birdweather-consistent: excludes 668 low-probability detections (probability<=0.045) whose species/UTC-day cell is absent from BirdWeather's own dailyDetectionCounts aggregates

format.description: Detections per species per local (America/New_York) date per hour. species[i] matches data[i]. Each data[i] is a flat list of day records: [dayDelta, hourMask, count_h1, count_h2, ...]. dayDelta = days since the previous record for that species (first record: days since baseDate). hourMask is a 24-bit integer; bit h set means hour h (0-23 local) has a count; the counts follow in ascending hour order. Detections in the repeated 1 AM hour on DST fall-back nights are both counted in hour 1.
